identity.scope: Current main Farfold process plus system VM counters only; not a past-round reconstruction. WebKit/helper/Agent resources are not included. ps CPU is its own rolling estimate, not render latency. Thread counts use ps -M rows. Timing refers only to this sampler process.

limits: These are observations during the stated current window, not reconstruction of earlier performance rounds.
Resource window alone does not establish that either simulated stream was running, or establish stream overlap.
Main process RSS/CPU/thread counts exclude WebKit helpers and Agent child resources; system VM/CPU snapshots include unrelated system activity.
ps CPU percentages are OS estimates, not application input/switch event-to-paint timings.
OS top snapshot is later than the sampling window and is separately timestamped.
mutations: Only candidate5-performance-resource-* evidence files written; no app/UI/request/fixture/profile/script/round changes.
